text: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs lets me read /etc/passwd. Details on request.

Hello, I noticed that your desktop client sometimes sends requests to an address I do not recognize when it starts up. I am not a security expert and I could not tell whether any personal data is included, but it seemed unusual, so I wanted to report it to your security team for review.

Hi, our annual SOC 2 audit starts on the 14th. Please upload last quarter's access review evidence and the updated vendor list to the shared audit folder by Friday, and block an hour next week for the auditor walkthrough. Thanks, Compliance
